scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark dashboard with a consistent muted-blue accent (#4477AA) across all views and subtle panel depth, but the network node labels overlap at 9px in the dense center and the color-scatter dots are too small to resolve individual hue/lightness clusters.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero-based bar chart baseline, scaleSqrt for all circle encodings (network and color scatter), data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, and fixed Y-scale on filtered timeline bars prevents axis jumping — all critical checks pass cleanly.
scores.stress_test_note: Correctly implements dirty-flag + RAF coalescing for all brush/pointer events, no feedback loops, no transitions to interrupt, and pointer events unify mouse/touch — only weakness is that brush closures capture x/y scales once at init with no resize handler, leaving scales stale if the viewport is resized.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked views (timeline, 60-node network, color scatter, block list) stay within working memory limits and form coherent filter dimensions, but the color scatter's density of overlapping dots and the 60-node network near the spaghetti threshold require a moment to parse — managed well by pre-run simulation, canvas rendering, and a restrained monochromatic palette.
